relevant_laws.quote: Whenever signals are placed over the individual lanes of a highway, the signals indicate, and apply to drivers of vehicles, as follows: A downward-pointing green arrow means that a driver facing the signal may drive in any lane over which the green signal is shown.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: overhead individual-lane permission for a facing bus driver
relevant_laws.notes: Highway status, official signal status, facing direction and lane mapping require retained source review.
